regions.today: Mostly dry today with plenty of sunshine and just isolated showers possible at first. Cooler than recently with highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light, occasionally moderate, northwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with long clear spells and patches of mist and fog forming in light northwesterly or variable breezes. Lowest temperatures of 1 to 5 degrees, with a touch of frost possible in places.
regions.tomorrow: Any mist and fog patches will clear tomorrow morning to leave a dry, bright and crisp day with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees with light northeasterly or variable breezes.
